name: @mgread-plugin/zhi35-iptv
description: MgRead IPTV aggregation with zhi35, iptv-org, YueChan and Free-TV backup lines.

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test test/contract.test.mjs test/source.test.mjs test/logos.test.mjs test/aggregation.test.mjs
scripts.pack:plugin: npm run build && node tools/mgread.mjs pack
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run pack:plugin

mgread.description: 整合 zhi35、iptv-org、YueChan 与 Free-TV 的公开电视列表，同频道可自动尝试备用或手动切换线路。支持央视、卫视、地方、港台及国际频道，播放取决于上游和所在网络，部分线路需要 IPv6。
